identified_risk: A row-wise mean after concatenating an optional compositional bank can make bank size an unintended loss coefficient and let numerous low-response counterfactual rows dominate the 806-row primary component.

clarification.query_axis_concatenation: retained for input and audit identity only
clarification.loss_reduction: compute a mean independently inside the primary component and every optional component, then take an unweighted mean over components
clarification.descriptor_triplet: computed once because it has no query-bank axis
clarification.component_weight: one divided by the number of active bank components

required_invariance_test: Uniformly duplicating every row of one optional component must not change its effective component weight or the reduced loss, up to floating-point reduction tolerance.
